# Jeroen Overschie
> I'm Jeroen 👋🏻
Public Ghost content for AI and LLM tooling. Use `/llms-full.txt` for consolidated page and post context.
Append `.md` to any post or page URL to get the content in Markdown (for example, `/example-post.md`).

## Posts
- [Our internal AI agent for expenses: Bonbonnetje 🍬](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/our-internal-ai-agent-for-expenses-bonbonnetje.md) - Bonbonnetje is an AI Agent running in production on Agent Platform helping Xebians submit expense claims. Bonbonnetje is in active use by multiple internal departments and successfully completes hundreds of submissions monthly, helping save both employees and back-office valuable time.
- [TEDXKE 2025](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/tedxke-2025.md) - Amersfoort, The Netherlands — TED-style Xebia knowledge sharing session (XKE) in the Flint theatre in Amersfoort, sharing experiences on a three month working engagement at a health-tech company in Kenya.
- [From Nanyuki to Nairobi with Kenya Railways](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/taking-the-train-from-nanyuki-to-nairobi-with-kenya-railways.md) - This is what it's like to travel from Nanyuki to Nairobi by train 🚂.
- [Fine-tuning LLMs yourself](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/fine-tuning-llms-yourself.md) - Fine-tuning can be a powerful way to specialised Large Language Models (LLMs). With open source models readily available, it is now also possible to fine-tune yourself. Read along to find out how.
- [Python Devcontainer with uv](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/python-devcontainer-with-uv.md) - Devcontainers are very powerful. So is uv. How do we combine the two?
- [Golden hour in Amsterdam](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/golden-hour-in-amsterdam.md) - 🫶
- [Are you ready for MLOps?](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/are-you-ready-for-mlops-on-xebia-com.md) - MLOps has survived the hype cycle and is gaining in maturity. But are we looking at MLOps for answers for the right things? When should you even start thinking about MLOps, or when is ‘plain’ DevOps wiser to focus on first?
- [Around the Amstel station](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/in-and-around-the-amstel-station.md) - Taking a good look at the Amsterdam Amstel station surroundings.
- [The GenAI automation potential of data extraction](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/the-genai-automation-potential-of-data-extraction-on-xebia-com.md) - GenAI has been around for a little while and its capabilities are expanding quickly. But still, many companies fail to generate actual value with GenAI. Why is that? In this blogpost, we explore the GenAI automation potential that exists today for data extraction.
- [The Levels of RAG](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/the-levels-of-rag.md) - LLM’s can be supercharged using a technique called RAG, allowing us to overcome dealbreaker problems like hallucinations or no access to internal data. But what can we expect from RAG? What use cases work well and which are more challenging? Let’s find out together!
- [PyData Eindhoven 2024](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/pydata-eindhoven-2024.md) - Eindhoven, The Netherlands — Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is powerful. Let's go from Basic (chunking, vector embeddings, nearest-neighbor search) to Hybrid Search (TF-IDF, BM-25 and Reciprocal Rank Fusion) to Advanced (PDF parsing, tables, graphs) and finally, the cutting edge: Multimodal.
- [PyData London 2024](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/pydata-london-2024.md) - London, United Kingdom — MLOps takes the best of DevOps and applies it to operationalizing ML, introducing concepts like experiment tracking, dataset versioning, model registries, ML pipelines, CI/CD and better observability. But MLOps goes beyond just tech- MLOps is also about People and Process.
- [AI Community Day 2024](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/ai-community-day-2024.md) - Utrecht, The Netherlands — LLMOps on Azure: scaling RAG applications, using Azure AI Search (keyword and vector search, reciprocal rank fusion), hosting LLM apps on Azure Container Apps, IaC with Terraform, robust CI/CD setups and an elaborate observability stack with Langfuse/OpenTelemetry.
- [RAG on GCP: production-ready GenAI on Google Cloud Platform](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/rag-on-gcp-production-ready-genai-on-google-cloud-platform.md) - GCP has an increasing set of managed services that can help you build production-ready Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications. How can you best leverage them to build RAG applications? Let’s explore together. Read along!
- [PyCon SK 2024](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/pycon-sk-2024.md) - Bratislava, Slovakia — What are the prerequisites you need before you can properly adopt MLOps? Let's learn together: why MLOps, what it is, how it relates to DevOps- and how you can best adopt it.
- [Dataset enrichment using LLM’s ✨](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/dataset-enrichment-using-llms.md) - Large Language Models (LLM's) have proven to be useful for numerous tasks. LLM's can summarise text, generate text, classify text or translate text. What LLM's can also be used for is converting unstructured data to structured data.
- [Scaling up: bringing your Azure DevOps CI/CD setup to the next level 🚀](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/scaling-up-bringing-your-azure-devops-ci-cd-setup-to-the-next-level.md) - Azure DevOps pipelines are a great way to automate your CI/CD process. But what if you have many projects? In this blog post, we will show you how you can scale up your Azure DevOps CI/CD setup for reusability and easy maintenance.
- [PyData Eindhoven 2023](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/pydata-eindhoven-2023-dataset-enrichment-using-llms.md) - Eindhoven, The Netherlands — LLM data extraction: prompt engineering, JSON output modes, Function calling, Pydantic schemas, evaluation and a GPT 3.5 vs GPT 4 vs PaLM showdown.
- [GoDataFest 2023](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/godatafest-dataset-enrichment-using-llms.md) - Amsterdam, The Netherlands — How can we extract more value from data by using what LLMs can offer us? Previously impossible data extractions can be now done and a new level of data quality and direct filtering can now be realized.
- [DataMass Gdańsk Summit 2023](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/datamass-2023-dataset-enrichment-using-llms.md) - Gdańsk, Poland — Enriching datasets with LLMs: JSON output modes, schema definitions with Pydantic, evaluating structured data extraction, Function Calling.
- [A sunrise in Hamburg](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/a-sunrise-in-hamburg.md) - 0:00 /0:27 1× Sometimes, it's nice just to observe. To watch, as the world wakes up. Have a great day ☀
- [PyData Eindhoven 2022](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/pydata-eindhoven-2022-how-to-create-a-devcontainer-for-your-python-project.md) - Eindhoven, The Netherlands — Devcontainer deep dive. Covering the Devcontainers rationale, the new containers.dev specification by the Microsoft team, Linux Docker essentials, mounts, ports, IDE integration and a practical guide on how you can create a Devcontainer for a Python project yourself.
- [How to create a Devcontainer for your Python project 🐳](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/how-to-create-a-devcontainer-for-your-python-project.md) - Instead of giving other developers a setup document, let’s make sure we also create formal instructions so we can automatically set up the development environment. Devcontainers let us do exactly this.
- [GoDataFest 2022](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/godatafest-2022-how-to-create-a-devcontainer-for-your-python-project.md) - Amsterdam, The Netherlands — Talk on Devcontainers. Motivating developer environment discrepancies, their consequences and the resolution: using Devcontainers. Covers the Devcontainer specification, linux user permissions, filesystem mounts, opening up ports, running Devcontainers in CI and more.
- [pyspark-bucketmap](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/pyspark-bucketmap.md) - pyspark-bucketmap is a tiny module for pyspark which allows you to bucketize DataFrame rows and map their values easily.
- [DropBlox: Coding Challenge at PyCon DE & PyData Berlin 2022](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/dropblox-coding-challenge-at-pycon-de-pydata-berlin-2022.md) - Conferences are great. You meet new people, you learn new things. But have you ever found yourself back in the hotel after a day at a conference, thinking what to do now? - [From Linear Regression to Neural Networks](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/from-linear-regression-to-neural-networks.md) - How are linear regression, logistic regression and neural networks related? What is overfitting and how do we fight it? In this post, we find answers to these questions in an interactive way by working with a real-world dataset on penguins.
- [Making Art with Generative Adversarial Networks](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/making-art-with-generative-adversarial-networks.md) - Can computers make art? To find out, we tried ourselves. We used Generative Adversarial Networks to try to paint new Van Gogh paintings.
- [Finding 'God' components in Apache Tika](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/finding-god-components-in-apache-tika.md) - How did big, bulky software components come into being? In this project, we explore the evolution of so-called God Components; pieces of software with a large number of classes or lines of code that got very large over time. Our analysis was run on the Apache Tika codebase. In this project, we set…
- [Backdoors in Neural Networks](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/backdoors-in-neural-networks.md) - Demonstrating a 'backdoor' security vulnerability. Trained networks in PyTorch and MXNet with ImageNet dataset on a supercomputer cluster. Demo with React.js app, using ONNX.js on-device inference. ✩ Project was rated 'best of class 2020'
- [COVID-19 Dashboard](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/covid-19-dashboard.md) - What parts of the world are susceptible to Corona outbreak? We used Big Data and Data Engineering in this project to find out.
- [Automated curtains project](https://jeroenoverschie.nl/automated-curtains.md) - My electric curtains can already be controlled by a remote. It would be cool if they could open in the morning, like an alarm clock. What if I could do this using a Raspberry Pi, by emulating the remote?
